mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS over the past month signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS does not decline for the past month or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 1% signals inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the CPIAUCSL increase is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) or returns are not negative.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDPC1 (demand) and HOUST (demand) indicates robust economic activity, driving positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: If the proxies do not move in tandem or 5-day returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), a concurrent rise in INDPRO (supply) signals reduced demand pressures, yielding positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS does not rise sufficiently or returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained UNRATE increase above 4% for a month indicates labor market weakening, resulting in negative 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: If the UNRATE increase is not sustained or returns are not negative.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in INDPRO below 100 for three months signals oversupply, leading to negative 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: If INDPRO does not decline sufficiently or returns are not negative.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in FEDFUNDS coupled with an increase in GDPC1 (demand) indicates dual easing, boosting equity valuations and driving positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If the proxies do not move in tandem or 5-day returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market tightening cycle (PAYEMS rising), a concurrent rise in UNRATE signals weakening labor demand, causing negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: If the proxies do not rise together or returns are not negative.
